change_summary: Added an audit/screen-only script that reruns the current accepted stack on the three fixed OHLCV snapshots, computes day-1/day-2/day-3 entry follow-through, groups final outcomes by follow-through bucket, and estimates a 25% add-on at the next open after qualifying checkpoints. No production strategy code was changed.

delta_metrics.decision_basis: Deferred positive: approximate add-on PnL is positive in all fixed windows, and the stricter day-2 +2% with positive RS candidate avoids the weaker old-thin ordinary-positive-follow-through bucket. However, trade-level approximation is not enough for promotion because it ignores portfolio heat, cash, cap, add-on stop handling, and equity-curve Sharpe.

hypothesis: Early entry follow-through may identify positions that deserve more capital. Recent accepted improvements came from letting proven winners earn more, while weak-hold exits failed; therefore adding small incremental exposure after strong early confirmation may be a better lifecycle alpha than selling early weakness.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft-ranking remains blocked by candidate-level replay coverage; this deterministic lifecycle add-on audit deliberately avoided LLM changes.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull where entry follow-through strongly identified target winners
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where stricter follow-through still produced positive add-on approximation
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak tape where broad positive follow-through was noisy but +2% follow-through remained positive

next_retry_requires: Implement a real backtester add-on/pyramiding replay for day2 unrealized >= +2% and RS vs SPY > 0
Respect portfolio heat, cash, per-position cap, and stop/target lifecycle for incremental shares
Do not promote broad positive follow-through add-ons before the stricter candidate is production-path tested
If real replay fails, record whether failure comes from cash/cap constraints or from add-on signal quality
notes: This was alpha_search, not measurement repair. It changed no production strategy code and produced the next actionable candidate mechanism.

parameters.parity_warning: trade-level approximation only; does not model portfolio heat, cash usage, per-position cap, add-on stop handling, or equity-curve Sharpe
